research.notes: The email domain (myceliumyouth.org) differs from the website domain (myceliumyouthnetwork.org) but is the address shown on the organization's own site. No street or mailing address found on the site; CA SOS entity number and SAM UEI not checked/found.

profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Oakland, California, that works with young people on climate resilience. Its programs combine education, storytelling, games, research and community action, and it runs a Climate Resilient Schools program with Bay Area schools.

sources.title: Mycelium Youth Network - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: ProPublica confirms the Oakland 501(c)(3) with EIN 85-0663137, and the CEQAnet record names Mycelium Youth Network as grantee at MetWest High School in partnership with OUSD, matching the agenda titles. The website shows the phone, email and Oakland base, and the summary is neutral and supported.
